parsed.lessons_learned: V3 tick math is CRITICAL to understand when evaluating pool liquidity. PoolMaster's 'out of range' liquidity was predictable if I had tracked the tick numbers more carefully. When selling a token in a V3 pool, I'm moving the price DOWN (more negative tick), which can actually bring me INTO a liquidity range that's below current price. This means attempting to sell ROCKET might actually work even with 'zero active liquidity' because the sell pressure itself pushes price into the range. Test small amounts first, then scale.
